full_track.tags: K-pop dance track with funk and disco influences. Features a prominent slap bass line, syncopated electric guitar scratches, and bright brass stabs. The percussion consists of a crisp snare, hi-hat sixteenth-note patterns, and a punchy kick. High-energy female vocals utilize a mix of rhythmic delivery and melodic belts. Synthesizer layers include shimmering pads and staccato lead accents. Tempo is 124 BPM in the key of B minor.
